FAUSTO COMMERCIAL PRESENTS

1726 Roosevelt St offers a legal duplex configured as three rental units: a 2BR/2BA main home, a 1BR/1BA efficiency, and a detached 1BR/1BA guest house. Roofs on both structures were replaced in early 2020. Interiors feature central A/C, tile and vinyl flooring, updated kitchen appliances, and shuttered windows, with four parking spaces on site.

The main unit and detached unit are currently vacant; both previously rented for $2,600 and $1,200 per month respectively. The efficiency is occupied at $1,200 per month. With two of three units vacant, an owner can set new rents at acquisition.
